title: Anyone using AI to look at the WoW economy?

posts.cooked: I've been playing around with the Blizzard Auction House API. I've exported the historical price data for some high-value mats like Arcanite and herbs, and fed it into a local LLM and some regression models to see if it can predict price swings. Has anyone had success doing this? The 1-hour delay in API updates makes it hard, but I think there's a huge potential for AI-assisted trading in-game.
